text:
Jesse (partnerships): FYI BrightGrid asked for a quick red-team friendly POC next week. Need clarifications on tenant provisioning, POC pricing for Dedicated, and a few security questionnaire items. Can we triage? :spiral_notepad:
Maya (eng-sales): I can take tenant provisioning steps. Is this a shared tenant (partner-managed) or do we spin a Redwood sandbox?
Jesse (partnerships): Partner wants us to spin a sandbox in their VPC but they want the control plane to be Redwood-managed. They also want a short SLA for the demo window.
Ibrahim (solutions): Ok — for partner-VPC with Redwood control plane we need: subnet + NAT info, inbound rule for control-plane egress, and a service account for provisioning. I have a mini-runbook we can reuse.
Maya (eng-sales): Can you paste the runbook snippet? I can drop it into the onboarding doc.
Ibrahim (solutions): Sure — use this as an example for infra team:
```
# example terraform to create service account + route
resource "google_service_account" "redwood_poc" {
  account_id   = "redwood-poc-sa"
  display_name = "Redwood POC SA"
}
# allow control plane egress to redwood-internal.example.com
```
Connor (revops): Pricing question — BrightGrid expects Dedicated GPU during the POC. Do we offer short-term reserved pricing or a flat POC credit? They asked about hourly and a 2-week estimate.
Jesse (partnerships): They want something close to predictable pricing for 2 weeks. Maybe we provide discounted hourly with a cap, plus a usage report. @Connor any precedent?
Connor (revops): We have a Partner POC SKU: discount 40% off dedicated hourly for <=30 days, with a monthly-like cap pro-rated. I'll draft an offer and attach numbers. Need expected GPU size (A100-80GB vs A10G) and token forecast.
Ibrahim (solutions): For the demo flow they'll use embeddings + streaming chat. Estimate: 200k tokens/day peak, ~4 concurrent sessions. A10G should be fine for demo, A100 if they push latency-sensitive loads.
Eve-Security: Security questionnaire items: 1) Data residency (where will the request logs and prompt traces live?) 2) KMS/HSM support for customer keys 3) Audit log retention and access controls 4) Telemetry export (we need to confirm what we expose)
Jesse (partnerships): BrightGrid requires EU residency for logs and must have control of keys. They also asked for SOC2 and a short compliance attestation.
Eve-Security: Action items:
- Confirm logs live in partner VPC vs Redwood (we can push logs to partner S3/GCS with Glue-like endpoint)
- KMS: we support wrapping with customer-managed keys (KMS) — need partner key ARN and an IAM role. HSM on-prem is a special request (we'll escalate)
- Audit logs: default 90 days, can enable longer retention for enterprise add-on
I'll add answers to the questionnaire and flag HSM as escalation.
Maya (eng-sales): I'll send the questionnaire draft to BrightGrid and include the infra checklist.
deploy-bot: Tenant provisioning job queued for BrightGrid-demo-2026 — job id 4421 — status: pending
Ibrahim (solutions): Quick note on telemetry: we'll enable a read-only telemetry export to their GCS bucket. Example export policy:
```
exporter:
  destination: gs://brightgrid-redwood-telemetry
  format: jsonl
  retention: 90d
```
Jesse (partnerships): Great. Who's on the call with BrightGrid tomorrow at 10am PT? I can lead.
Maya (eng-sales): I'll join. Ibrahim can cover infra. Eve-Security if possible for the 15-min compliance Q&A?
Eve-Security: I can be on for first 15 minutes.
Connor (revops): I'll send the preliminary pricing PDF after the call.
Jesse (partnerships): Plan: 1) Call tomorrow 10am PT, 2) provision sandbox (Ibrahim / deploy-bot), 3) RevOps sends POC pricing, 4) Security answers questionnaire and flags HSM if needed. I'll post a checklist after the call. :white_check_mark:
Maya (eng-sales): Sounds good. I'll ping BrightGrid and share calendar invite.
Jesse (partnerships): Thanks everyone — let's try to have infra ready by EOD Friday so BrightGrid can smoke test on Monday.
Connor (revops): Noted. I'll include token/cost estimates in the offer.
deploy-bot: Tenant provisioning job 4421 updated — status: in_progress
Ibrahim (solutions): If anyone needs the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-provisioning (private).
Jesse (partnerships): Closing thread for now; will reopen with post-call notes.
